rounds.assistant: This code uses the Adafruit NeoPixel library to control an array of 27 NeoPixels connected to pin 6 of an Arduino board. The code sets up a button on pin 2 and uses it to increment a variable "blueInvader" when pressed. As the variable increases, the code sets the corresponding NeoPixel to be red while setting the previous one to be blue. This creates an animation of a blue "invader" moving through the NeoPixel array. The delay function is used to slow down the animation so that it can be easily seen.
